prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a hit while turning left. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1233; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours are far more than the damage needs, about three times a normal estimate.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Inspection of the left front and fender area shows crush and paint transfer that fit a side-angle strike during a left turn, and most of the visible damage follows that impact pattern. The billing records reviewed so far contain no repeated line items. However, the labor hours on this estimate run roughly three times what a repair of this scope normally requires, so the shop should justify each block of time before approval. No prior damage to the vehicle is known to this office. Proposed plan: replace the bumper cover, repair the fender, refinish adjacent panels, and recheck alignment after the work is complete.
